✅ Definition (Simplified): 
Load balancer is like a traffic controller for your servers. It takes user requests and 
distributes them to multiple servers, so no single server gets overloaded. 
 
🧠 Eppadi Work Aagudhu? 
1.​ Client request anupuraanga (Browser, App etc.)​
 
2.​ Load Balancer request-ai receive pannum.​
 
3.​ Available server list-la irundhu oru server choose pannum.​
 
4.​ Request-ai andha server-ku forward pannum.​
 
5.​ Response vandhudum — user-ku happy!​
 
 
🔧 Types of Load Balancer

2.​ L7 Load Balancer – Based on HTTP headers, cookies, content path etc.​

irundhu pannalum, different servers handle pannum. Load balancer dhaan decide pannum — 
“Inga crowd jasthi, inga server idle irukku, let's send request here.”

●​ High availability​

🔁 Caching Strategy Types (Tamil style): 
1.​ Read-Through Cache​
 App try pannum: “Cache-la irukkaa?” → illa-na DB → then store in cache.​
 
2.​ Write-Through Cache​
 App data write pannum pothu — cache kum DB-kum rendu edathukum same time 
update pannum.​
 
3.​ Write-Behind Cache​
 App mudhala cache-kku write pannum → DB-kku later update aagum (background-la).​
 
4.​ TTL (Time To Live)​
 Cache-la irukka data ku expiry timer vechiruvom. Old aana data auto delete aagum.​
